doc: Conformant-absence registry (SSOT). Cases whose conformance property is DUT BEHAVIOUR (it must reject malformed input, or must not emit a prohibited frame) rather than a comparison against an operator-supplied expected value. A --expect negative cannot fault a conformant DUT on these, so they carry NO NEG_ROWS entry; their guard's non-vacuity is structural (the named fail final exists and is reachable by a misbehaving DUT) and is empirically provable only on the DUT-mutation track. See docs/verdict_policy.md Section 6. Validated by tools/negative_coverage_audit.py.

classes.malformed_rejection: DUT must answer malformed input with an Error Response / non-OK return code; the named fail final fires iff the DUT returns an OK echo.
classes.behavioral_absence: DUT must NOT exhibit a prohibited behaviour (emit after stop, ack an invalid subscribe, respond on a forbidden window); the named fail final fires iff the behaviour is observed.
classes.liveness: DUT must emit an expected frame; its absence over the window is inconclusive and there is no fail final (binary present/absent, no malformed variant to reject).

SOMEIP_ETS_041.property: DUT must answer a UTF-16 request whose inner string-length prefix is truncated with an Error Response, not an OK echo

SOMEIP_ETS_043.property: DUT must answer a UTF-16 request carrying an odd byte before the null terminator with an Error Response, not an OK echo

SOMEIP_ETS_050.property: DUT must answer a UTF-8 request whose inner string-length prefix is truncated with an Error Response, not an OK echo
